question.text: Per the introductory chapter on participants, which categories of mutual fund schemes are identified as permitted to participate in commodity derivative markets?

answer.text: Hybrid Mutual Fund Schemes and Multi-Asset Mutual Fund Schemes
All categories of mutual fund schemes

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the introductory chapter on participants, SEBI has permitted Hybrid Mutual Fund Schemes and Multi-Asset Mutual Fund Schemes to participate in commodity derivative markets. The Trap: Not every mutual fund category is allowed — pure equity-only or debt-only schemes are not included in the permitted list at the introductory chapter level. Note: The later detailed participant chapter additionally lists exposure routes such as Gold ETFs and also flags prohibitions in the options segment; that wider detail is outside the scope of this introductory-chapter question.
